name: Jiajun Chen
intro: I completed my bachelor's degree in Data Science and Big Data Technology at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications. During my senior year, I visited the National University of Singapore and worked as a research intern at CVML Lab, advised by Prof. Angela Yao and Prof. Junbin Xiao.

Now, I am a research intern under the guidance of Prof. Xihui Liu at HKU MMLab, where I focus on embodied AI, egocentric video generation, and game world models. I'm currently open to industry internship opportunities and research collaborations. If you are interested in my work and would like to discuss potential collaborations, feel free to contact me via email! 🥰
